items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Monk Rowe' (the interviewer), not the jazz pianist Thelonious Monk. There is no evidence of a relationship with Thelonious Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Orlando at the MLA conference, and I’m very happy to have Vincent Pelote with me today, Director of Operations at the Institute of Jazz Studies at Rutgers. Welcome.
You’ve been perking my ears up the last couple of days when I hear you talking to other people. And I can sense your passion for jazz and I’m going to start out with an easy question.
